rationale: Privative ⲧⲙ̄- + ⲡⲣⲉ ('sun,' = ⲡⲣⲏ). Designates a hellish locus paired with 'place of judgment' and 'night of darkness' as Death's destination. The sun-correspondence makes 'sunless' more precise than generic 'dark place.' Tentative.

Substantival noun from ⲧⲱϩ 'join, mix, match.' Functions as the technical correspondential identifier in formulas like ⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲓ̈ ⲡⲧⲏⲍ ⲁⲛ ⲁ-X 'this also matches X.' Names the act of typological correspondence between cosmic and material registers.
Causative ⲡ̄-ⲧ-ⲣⲉⲛ from ϯⲣⲉⲛ 'give a name' (in glossary as ϯⲡⲉⲛ). Substantivized as 'the act of naming.' Used here in temporal idiom ⲙ̄ⲡⲁⲧⲉ ⲡⲧⲣⲉⲛ 'before the naming' = 'before they have been named.'

Compound: ⲧⲉϩ- ('his') + ⲃⲓ ('bear, bring forth') + ⲙ̄ⲡⲣⲓⲉ ('the shining,' from same root as ⲡⲡⲣⲓ̈ⲉ 'the Radiance' in glossary). Action-noun for the sun's/Illuminator's act of bringing-forth-the-shining at sunrise. Paired with ⲍⲱⲡⲧ̄ 'setting' as the diurnal mystery-pair.

Greek loanword ἀσκέω 'practice, exercise, train (in asceticism).' Lyc. ⲣⲁⲥⲕⲏ shows ⲣ-onset for Greek ἀσκ-. Used here in paraenetic command paired with ⲧⲁϣⲉⲁⲓϣ 'proclaim': the brothers must train themselves and proclaim to the souls.

Variant of accumulated ⲡⲓⲣⲏⲧⲉ 'this manner' / ⲡⲛⲟ 'the manner' (in glossary as ⲧⲛⲟ). Used here in correspondence formula ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲣⲏⲛⲧⲉ ⲙ̄ⲡⲣⲏ 'according to the manner of the sun.' Standard discourse-marker introducing typological comparisons.

Compound ⲙⲁⲛ- ('place of') + ⲱⲡⲧ (qualitative of ⲱⲡ 'count, reckon, judge,' already in glossary). Eschatological locus where Death goes to render account. Standard Manichaean cosmographic term for the post-mortem reckoning-station.
Compound: ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who') + ϫⲓⲟⲩⲁ ('utter blasphemy') with Lyc. ⲭ for ϫ. Standard Coptic agentive formation paralleling ⲣⲉϩ†ⲥⲃⲱ 'teacher.' Listed alongside ⲛⲁⲣⲛⲏⲧⲏⲥ 'deniers' as the damned class.
